seo.metaTitle: Rewriter (rule-based) — free in your browser, no upload | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Rewrite wordy text, convert prose to bullets or formalise it with fixed rules in your browser. Deterministic, offline, no AI model and no upload.
seo.aeoSummary: This rewriter applies fixed editing rules to your text inside your browser tab — no language model, no download and no upload. The same input always produces the same output.

faqs.question: Does this tool upload my files my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No model is called. The rewrite is a fixed set of substitution and formatting rules running in this tab, so the output is deterministic and nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Zero-download AI writer & rewriter (0 MB)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/ai_writer.json or open /tools/ai-writer?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
